scope: Only delta from bootstrap bfeecc66 to v2 8512901a; existing fixed helper/binary pins and prior failed-attempt cleanup reused

findings.title: Use the supported cross-process control-text API for the required Static marker
findings.trigger: The Static child is owned by the Host process, not the Root Python process. wt() uses GetWindowTextW and treats its returned buffer as the control text.
findings.impact: GetWindowTextW is not the supported way to retrieve another process's control text and can provide no marker. The only matching branch then waits until the UI deadline while a real picker exists.
findings.minimum_fix: Send WM_GETTEXT (0x000D, a system message below WM_USER) through SendMessageTimeoutW with a local writable UTF-16 buffer, capacity and a timeout bounded by the remaining UI deadline. Check the actual send completion and text length; record failure in the callback error channel. Preserve Host-owned initial selection and pointer-free BM_CLICK.

findings.title: Catch exceptions inside each ctypes enumeration callback
findings.trigger: enum_top or enum_child raises after an earlier matching child/window has already been collected, for example a metadata read error after R01 is made fail-closed.
findings.impact: ctypes reports callback exceptions as unraisable; the enclosing Python try/except does not receive them. Partial children/matches can survive, so one collected match can be accepted without a successful complete enumeration.
findings.minimum_fix: Wrap both callbacks in their own try/except BaseException, append stage/HWND/error to shared callback_errors and return False on error. After every enumeration reject callback_errors before consuming children or matches. Do not rely on EnumChildWindows return value to propagate Python callback exceptions.

findings.title: Bind confirmation to the selected workspace before publishing it
findings.trigger: The Shell picker closes after a different directory is selected, whether the initial preselection was not applied or a user changed it. CLI init can still successfully create a project bound to that directory.
findings.impact: The code sets confirmed_by_native_cli_result=True after only CLI success and dialog disappearance. It does not compare the actual Host workspace binding behind the returned workspace_ref with requested_workspace. The receipt can therefore confirm the intended workspace while the project uses another root.
findings.minimum_fix: Before publishing the confirmed flag, derive the actual chosen/bound root from the native-result/Host binding using the returned workspace_ref and compare its canonical directory with the unique intended workspace. Require the same ref in init result and persisted config; keep requested_workspace labelled as intent until this check succeeds.
findings.evidence: apps/cli/cli_contract.go passes the actual chooser-selected path into workspace.register/project.bootstrap and emits workspace_ref/result; the new producer currently checks only project_id and empty session_id.

positive_findings: Original Host same-process initial selection remains unchanged; no custom cross-process pointer message is sent.
BM_CLICK uses zero WPARAM/LPARAM. SendMessageTimeoutW completion is distinguished from the message result, which is not treated as click success.
ctypes HWND/WPARAM/LPARAM and output DWORD_PTR widths match the ABI. c_size_t rather than signed LRESULT does not affect the used zero/nonzero completion check; this is not a blocker.
The selected dialog is tied to the held Host PID/creation and a live primary process, with exact class/title marker and enabled IDOK.
The UI stop/join and unconfirmed-thread inclusion preserve the same parent on unconfirmed UI/Job cleanup; Host60s/CLI init20s remain pre-trial zero-provider scope.
